solutions.title: Hold/cash dynamic state
solutions.strategy: Track the best balance when holding a share and when holding cash after each day.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each day updates the two states once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the current hold and cash balances are stored.

solutions.title: Sum positive daily gains
solutions.strategy: Every upward adjacent price movement can be captured as part of some valid sequence of non-overlapping trades.

timeComplexity.explanation: The algorithm scans adjacent day pairs once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only an accumulated profit counter is stored.
